title: API Route Compiler
description: Formal compiler for HTTP API route handlers: parse intent → scaffold → implement → test → verify → attest

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract route spec: method, path, input schema, output schema, auth requirements, error cases

pipeline.title: Scaffold
pipeline.description: Generate file structure: handler, schema, types, test stub, OpenAPI fragment

pipeline.title: Implement
pipeline.description: Write full handler with input validation, auth check, business logic, error handling

pipeline.title: Test
pipeline.description: Write and run unit tests: happy path, validation errors, auth errors, edge cases

pipeline.title: Verify
pipeline.description: Cross-check handler against spec, OpenAPI shape, and route contract

pipeline.title: Attest
pipeline.description: Produce signed route-artifact.json for the registry

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: route-spec.json exists with required fields: method, path, input, output, auth

gates.title: Schema Valid
gates.description: schema.ts parses without error and exports InputSchema + OutputSchema

gates.title: Auth Present
gates.description: If spec.auth !== 'none', handler calls auth middleware or checks token before business logic

gates.title: Error Codes
gates.description: Handler returns correct HTTP status codes: 400 validation, 401 unauth, 403 forbidden, 404 not found, 500 server

gates.title: Input Validated
gates.description: All req.body/req.query/req.params access goes through schema.parse() before use

gates.title: No Raw SQL
gates.description: No raw SQL string literals — must use ORM, query builder, or parameterized queries

gates.title: No TODOs
gates.description: No TODO/FIXME/HACK/PLACEHOLDER in handler or schema files

gates.title: Tests Pass
gates.description: All handler unit tests pass with zero failures

gates.title: OpenAPI Shape
gates.description: openapi.json is valid OpenAPI 3.1 fragment with correct method, path, request/response schemas

gates.title: Route Contract
gates.description: Handler matches route.contract.json: method, path pattern, auth level, error shape

gates.title: Schema Alignment
gates.description: If schema-artifact.json exists, route input/output fields must align with schema fields. Schema is the source of truth.

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled API route handlers

error_codes.AR002: Schema file invalid or missing exports
error_codes.AR003: Auth middleware missing on protected route
error_codes.AR004: HTTP status codes incorrect or missing
error_codes.AR012: Route input/output fields conflict with schema
error_codes.AR013: Protected route missing compiled auth-middleware artifact
error_codes.AR014: Route uses DB but missing compiled db-migration artifact
